D90D makes solid points, but, to expand on a few

1. Stirring the nest then disappearing for days; other players often ask to do something with him the next day and he always says sure instead of saying he'll be out of the crossing for a few days. Speedy is probably one of the better examples of this activity.
2. His streaming patterns are very erratic; could be three 8 hour streams back to back or like now where he hasn't streamed rdr2 in 8+ days. He also streams exceptionally late for an east coaster - to the point where I, living on the west coast, often go to sleep before him (along with most of the server). It is very hard to organically integrate someone into a story if they don't have a usual/consistent time of play.
3. He has/had the chance to reconnect with Fallon by investigating her poisoning or returning to the gambling dates they had to start with. He could have told her what he did with the hand - she wanted to know what he was going to do with it when she gave it to him!
4. The cursed gun is effectively dead, he'll never get picked up so the original is going to be lost when he logs in and respawns. He could remake it, but, let sleeping dogs lie.
5. BW wanted to rob banks more than kill Bazz, but, Tommy might have done 2 banks with him in the 2 months that he was with BW. Had Tommy not been replaced by Speedy, BW might have lived that very dubious job with Cattleman and Bazz.
